title: How Jarvis 2.0 Works
lede: Jarvis 2.0 doesn’t wait for you to ask. It runs your agency with you, every day, toward one number.
deliverable: They leave knowing what runs on its own, what they do, and how every lesson works from here.
body:
Know what’s running, so you know what to expect from it.

Four parts that work together

PartWhat it does for you
The brainHow Jarvis thinks. It looks at your business, works out what makes money soonest and does that first. Sales calls beat outreach, every time.
The rhythmWhat Jarvis does on its own. A morning brief and an afternoon check-in every working day, your numbers every Friday, and it watches your replies all day. Check-ins come to WhatsApp or Telegram if you connect them.
The missionsYour path to your first client, in 19 steps, one at a time. Each one only counts when the proof is in your HUD.
The HUDYour agency on one screen: what needs you, your pipeline, leads, campaigns, clients and results. You can talk to Jarvis from it.

Learn it once. Every module works the same way.

How every Jarvis lesson works

  1. Install, once per module. The module’s first lesson gives you a file. Attach it in Jarvis and send the install message. Jarvis lists what it installed.
  2. Run. Each lesson gives you one message that names the skill it uses, like “Use the offer creation skill to write my offer.” You never paste what Jarvis already knows.
  3. Check. Each lesson tells you what you should see when it worked.

When a skill gets better, a lesson tells you. Attach the new file and send:

Update these skills. Keep all my data. Tell me which versions changed.

And whenever you’re not sure what’s next:

Where am I?

The reason students finish this course.

Why this is different

Most AI tools wait for you to know what to ask. Jarvis knows where you are, what’s next and what’s making money, and it tells you before you ask. It checks its own work, it never makes up a number, and when something breaks it fixes it with you instead of handing you an error.

Before continuing: you can name the four parts and the three steps of every lesson.
